name: @hl-bos/highlightai-football
description: HighlightAI Football — upload the game, pick the player, HighlightAI does the rest. Assembled on HL-BOS: reuses HL-BOS identity/tenancy/permissions and the `highlight` schema, and runs @hl-bos/highlight-football for every decision it displays. Ships with demo adapters so the whole workflow is walkable before the GPU models are complete; demo output is labelled as demo everywhere it appears.
